snippet.title: ScooterFlow | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
After years in the making ScooterFlow 1.0 is finally LIVE worldwide on Xbox Series X/S, PS5 & Steam.

Play Now on PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10017808
Play Now on Xbox Series X/S: https://www.xbox.com/en-NZ/games/store/scooterflow/9p8l46zg255f
Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1648390/ScooterFlow/

Ride the skatepark, hit the streets, boost the mega ramp, fully customize your scooter & throw down all of the real life trick combinations you could dream of in the world's most realistic freestyle scooter game.

Song: You Smell Like Phys Ed
Artist: Swimming

#ScooterFlow
